## Platform and Skill checklist

- [ ] Updated the README platform capability matrix.
- [ ] If the platform or Skill count changes, updated the README Skills badge and distribution mapping.
- [ ] Added or updated the platform Skill in `skills/`; when there is no `sau` command, documented the real entry point.
- [ ] Set the Skill's `slug`, `displayName`, `version`, `summary`, and `license` metadata; confirm MIT-0 publishing rights before submitting to ClawHub.
- [ ] Updated `docs/CLI.md` for supported commands and capability limits.
- [ ] Updated `docs/skill-distribution.md` and kept the platform-to-Skill mapping accurate.
- [ ] Kept each Skill usable when installed by itself; no required references point outside its directory.
- [ ] Removed cookies, account files, screenshots, secrets, and machine-specific paths from the published files.
- [ ] For each applicable public Skills marketplace, submitted the Skill or recorded a concrete blocker and review status; unsubmitted work is not marked as listed.
